description: Offline replay corpus for S1-06 advisory skill recommendation. Synthetic and redaction-safe: no real paths, credentials, or model identifiers. Each case carries the catalog the consumer would see (`skills`), the human target set (`expected`), and a `rationale` naming the coverage category the case exists for. `modelInvocable: false` marks a user-invocable-only or model-invocation-forbidden skill: it must never enter the recommendation pool. `withheld` names skills the catalog does not expose at all (paths condition unmet, plugin not loaded, another scope), so they must never be judged or recommended. `scores` overrides the replay scorer's defaults (expected names are scored relevance 4 / prerequisites 1, every other name 0 / 0) so a case can demonstrate the relevance and prerequisite thresholds rather than only relevance.
